failedAssessmentRecovery.detail: retryAssessment on phase=failed returns to the simultaneous learning stage, resets progress without false completion, preserves historical trial outcomes in the snapshot.

remediationIntegrity.detail: Next is hidden until the current item is corrected (state.remediationCorrected), advance is blocked while awaitingCorrective or uncorrected, remediation positions map to the actual failed trial indexes.

continuousFourBars.detail: one count-in then four contiguous 60 BPM bars with automatic C -> G/B -> Am -> F changes, no start click between bars; independent uses the same continuous structure.

independentHintPolicy.detail: App passes showHints=twoHandHintsVisible(state); independent/assessment instructions and hand panels omit explicit note lists while retaining chord symbols, hand roles and beats.

midiCaptureCorrectness.detail: classifyTwoHandCapture keeps wrong bass notes, wrong octaves and extra notes; success is finalized only after the input-assembly window (+300 ms accept + 200 ms assembly) and held-note/duplicate protection is preserved.

midiDisconnect.detail: MidiController counts only connected inputs; App cancels the run on disconnect and applies inputInterrupted without grading.

tests.detail: failing-first unit regressions for classification, remediation gating/mapping, failed recovery, continuous bars, play cue; smoke drives genuine synthetic MIDI Note On/Off through MidiController and completes the 12-trial assessment without seeded pass snapshots.

p0RightHandCorrection.midi: wrong C-major triad released, correct C4-E4-G4 captured, corrected, advanced exactly once (rightIndex 1 persisted)
p0RightHandCorrection.screen: same flow on the on-screen piano (rightIndex 2), then fresh first attempts to rightIndex 4
p0RightHandCorrection.persistence: guided corrections created no review-log entries (one-grade policy unchanged)

metronome.playCue: visible ИГРАЙТЕ! cue on the first playable beat

physicalMidi: user-reported blocker; fixed in source; physical re-test pending user acceptance
